invitation.subject: {{inviter}} shared a {{kind}} with you on OxiCloud
invitation.body:
{{inviter_full}} shared a {{kind}} with you on OxiCloud.

Open it by clicking the link below:
{{link}}

The link works once and expires in {{ttl_hours}} hours.
If you didn't expect this invitation, you can safely ignore this message.

— OxiCloud

login.subject: Sign in to OxiCloud
login.body:
Hello,

Use the link below to sign in to OxiCloud. The link works once and expires in {{ttl_minutes}} minutes. Open it on the same device where you requested it.

{{link}}

If you didn't request this sign-in link, you can safely ignore this message — no further action is needed.

— OxiCloud

share.subject: {{inviter}} shared a {{kind}} with you on OxiCloud
share.body:
{{inviter_full}} shared a {{kind}} with you on OxiCloud.

Open OxiCloud to see your new share:
{{login_link}}

You may have additional new shares from {{inviter}} — sign in to see all your shared items.

— OxiCloud

You're receiving this message because you have an OxiCloud account and your share-notification preference is on. You can turn it off in your profile (Email me when someone shares with me).

password_changed.subject: Your OxiCloud password was changed
password_changed.body:
Hello,

Your OxiCloud password was just changed at {{timestamp}} (UTC) from IP address {{ip}}.

If this was you, no action is needed — you can ignore this message.

If this was NOT you, contact your administrator immediately. Someone may have gained access to your account.

— OxiCloud

admin.drive_manage_policies_help: Policies are admin-only — drive owners cannot mutate them. Each toggle controls one enforcement gate.

drive_policy.forbid_sharing_help: Block per-file / per-folder grants (covers public links and external sharing as well). Drive-level membership still works.
drive_policy.forbid_public_links_help: Block anonymous share links on resources in this drive.
drive_policy.forbid_external_sharing_help: Block grants to external users (email invitations and pre-existing external accounts).
drive_policy.forbid_cross_drive_move_help: Block moving files or folders out to another drive. Does not stop download + re-upload.
drive_policy.forbid_owner_role_change_help: Only admin can add, remove, or demote drive Owners while this is on.
drive_policy.include_in_photo_index_help: Show image and video files from this drive in the Photos timeline and on the Places map. Default personal drives are opted in automatically; turn on for shared drives that genuinely hold photos (e.g. "Family Photos").
drive_policy.include_in_music_index_help: Include audio files from this drive in the Music library. Default personal drives are opted in automatically; turn on for shared drives that genuinely hold a music collection (e.g. "Family Music", "Band Collaboration").
drive_policy.implied_by_forbid_sharing: Already enforced by Forbid per-resource sharing.
drive_policy.read_only_help: Freeze the drive entirely — every mutation is refused (uploads, edits, deletes, renames, sharing, membership changes). Reads and downloads keep working. The trash-retention janitor also pauses. Use for archives, legal holds, or account wind-downs. Only an admin can un-freeze.
